plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: the phone sits at the left edge with the NEW FLAVOR sticker next to its shoulder as in the original, a big headline and subhead block takes the centre, and the logo sits above the CTA in a right-hand brand/action column.
The brand leads on the left, then the headline and subhead with the CTA left-aligned under them on one text edge, and the phone with its sticker closes the banner on the right.

A left-aligned editorial copy column (logo stacked above headline and subhead) is balanced by the phone and its sticker in the centre-right, with the CTA standing alone at the far right as the end of the reading path.
